text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning, while I'm in my room
getting ready
for the day...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Morning, Trainer! Wakey wakey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clack.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hehe, good mooorning!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee... Why do you think? Isn't it
obvious?!
choice_data_list: What brought this on all of a sudden?
What brought this on all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a hint: it's gonna make you

super-duper happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I mean, it can't possibly not make you happy since it came out so well! I used my spare carrots and everything!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I made sure not to eat all of 'em so
I could
make it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! I can't keep it a secret anymore!
Okay,
here you go!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ta-dah! I present to you... Urara-brand
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara hands me some
surprisingly—or
rather,
impressively—orange chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Whaddaya think? Looks tasty,
right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day is when we're supposed
to give
chocolate to people who are
close to us!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I worked real hard last night
making
this for you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I mashed the carrots, then whipped and
whirled
'em into the chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I thought you'd like carrot chocolate
over plain
ol' chocolate. You do, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's my pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of taking some to the
people in the
shopping district, too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Do you wanna come with? I bet
everyone'll be
happy to see you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! Okay, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I made everyone's chocolates super
special! I
matched the flavors to the
stores they work at!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I added veggies for the supermarket
lady, fish for
the fishmonger, and meat
for the butcher!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Riiight? I can't wait to see their
reactions!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Haru Urara and I spend a
busy
Valentine's Day in the shopping
district together.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Try a bite! It'll knock your socks off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Haru Urara's insistence, I take a
nibble.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ♪ You'd never guess it, but
there's a
secret to why it's so yummy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's the toppest of top secrets!
But if you
really
wanna know, I'll tell you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So? Do you wanna know?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I knew you couldn't resist! Here,
come
closer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So what I did was...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I poured aaall my love into the
chocolate while
thinking of how happy I
wanted to make you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ♪ It seems my hard work paid
off!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You'll share some of that with me as
thanks for
telling you my secret, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Haru Urara and I spend the
rest of the
day in bliss while sharing her
chocolates.
